objective: Bounded optical-height morphology and degradation-matched linear-head diagnostic; not CT ink detection or prize evidence.

split.design: explicit four-case subset of official leave-one-papyrus-out fold 5; not complete fold replication
split.selection_basis: metadata-only fixed small subset; no image/model-score-based selection

input_height.normalization: upstream per-sample normalized height; divide by 65535 only; no further per-sample normalization
input_height.original_missingness: original nonfinite/inpainting mask unavailable; no claim of excluding missingness artifacts

working_grid.label_native_rule: PNG converted to grayscale; nonzero foreground
working_grid.scoring_mask: fixed 32-working-pixel exclusion on all four sides; all remaining pixels; same labels/mask in all conditions

degradation.factor_interpretation: additional factors relative to the working grid, already blockmean4 from native; report factors only
degradation.method: factor>1: edge-pad working height bottom/right to factor multiple, nonoverlapping block mean, Pillow float32 bilinear resize to padded working shape, crop back to same working grid
degradation.labels_and_mask: never degraded, resampled, rethresholded or selected by output

features.height_scale: height divided by 65535 before block means
features.gradient: np.gradient of Gaussian(sigma=1) height; default edge_order=1

sampling.within_case_sampling: Equal count per class: min(8192, eligible ink count, eligible background count); uniform without replacement inside each class of fixed scoring mask; deterministic numpy Generator
sampling.reuse: identical sampled indices for every degradation condition and model
sampling.heldout: evaluate all fixed scored pixels; no class rebalance

models.convergence: record warning and n_iter; no increased iterations or parameter retry

evaluation.unit: each held-out case separately; both cases share one held-out papyrus
evaluation.ties: descending float32 score with stable row-major ties
primary_contrasts: full_train_f1 vs height_train_f1 and roughness_train_f1 at each factor
full_train_f2/f4 vs full_train_f1 on identical f2/f4 held-out inputs
evaluation.interpretation: descriptive paired held-out-case differences, no claims of significance or CT transfer

outputs.location: private work directory outside git repository
save: float32 probability maps and fixed scoring masks
per-case metrics and elapsed wall/CPU time
outputs.public_release: sanitized aggregate numeric results only; owner reviews provenance and interpretation

limitations: Optical profilometry of opened fragments is not CT imaging of rolled papyrus.
The selected four cases are a subset of official fold 5, not its published full protocol.
Both held-out cases come from PHerc. 500P2; there is one held-out specimen.
Height TIFFs are per-sample normalized and do not establish absolute micrometre relief.
Dataset calibration 0.68793625 um/pixel differs from paper 0.34 um/pixel; report degradation factors, not a physical resolution cutoff.
Original nonfinite/inpainting mask absent from normalized TIFF; missingness confounding cannot be excluded.
Working grid starts at blockmean4; working factor1 is not native optical resolution.
No trained backbone or target-scroll input; this does not establish First Letters model eligibility for another pipeline.

The fixed 32-working-pixel border matches the sigma8 kernel radius but degradation/interpolation adds support; a narrow inner band may retain edge-padding influence. The border is not changed after viewing results.
Balanced training scores are not calibrated probabilities of ink at the held-out prevalence.
